textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Christian: Released in 2022 and directed by Christian Tafdrup, the horror, thriller and drama feature Speak No Evil follows a Danish family vacationing in Tuscany. After befriending a Dutch family, they accept an invitation to spend a weekend at the new acquaintances' home, until a series of misunderstandings reveals that the hosts are not who they seemed to be.
textos.A experiência é estruturada sobre um rit: The experience is built on a slow, gradual rhythm, establishing a dense atmosphere defined by the continuous accumulation of psychological tension and discomfort.
textos.Os registros indicam que as diferentes f: The records indicate that the different rating ranges debate the same central themes, disagreeing strictly on the verdict about how the production works. In most ratings (~61%), a significant share stress the constant mood of discomfort and tension throughout the narrative. At the same time, a good portion of this group examine the passive stance and extreme politeness of the protagonists in the face of events, while a considerable number point out the impactful, brutal ending.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa parcela das: For those who sit at a share of the ratings (~28%), most criticize the excessive passivity of the lead characters and their apparent lack of survival instinct. Even so, many positively highlight the performances and the technical aspects, while several point to the slow pace and the building of discomfort. From the standpoint of a minimal fraction of ratings (~11%), the largest share disapprove of the characters' behavior as devoid of instinct, about half see the script as forced and illogical, and many judge the ending pretentious and unsatisfying.
